question: Which operational controls reduce false confidence in automated software composition?

documents.title: Immutable Inputs for Reproducible Integration
documents.full_text: An exact commit prevents a moving branch from silently changing the component under evaluation. The observed checkout identity must equal the requested revision.

documents.title: Negative Controls in Software Experiments
documents.full_text: A negative control should be deliberately broken at a known boundary. A useful evaluator must reject it even when the surrounding command exits successfully.

documents.title: Human Oversight of Machine Evidence
documents.full_text: Manual review compares retained observations with expectations written before execution. The reviewer records concrete reasons instead of trusting a green badge.

documents.title: Separating Security Signals
documents.full_text: Independent evidence keeps repository posture separate from known vulnerability results. Missing posture data remains unknown rather than becoming a passing score.

documents.title: Release Attestations and Provenance
documents.full_text: Package provenance requires a distribution attestation or equivalent release evidence. A valid source commit signature alone does not attest the published package file.

documents.title: Artifact Validation Beyond Exit Codes
documents.full_text: Process success shows only that execution completed. Functional confidence requires inspecting the produced artifact against the consumer contract.

documents.title: License Evidence Across Dependency Graphs
documents.full_text: A repository license does not clear every dependency license. Unknown, non-standard, and policy-sensitive dependency results must remain visible to reviewers.

documents.title: Disposable Environments for Candidate Code
documents.full_text: Candidate code should run at an immutable revision inside a disposable bounded environment. Host integrity and container cleanup are separate observations.

documents.title: Contract Tests at Component Boundaries
documents.full_text: Compatibility is demonstrated by applying the same workload to working and broken connections. Schema validation can expose a missing edge that raised no runtime exception.

documents.title: Raw Metrics for Agent Benchmarks
documents.full_text: Task success rate, wall time, cost, repair iterations, change success, and generated code should remain visible as raw metrics. A weighted score must not hide them.

documents.title: Tomato Irrigation in Summer
documents.full_text: Tomato plants benefit from consistent soil moisture and good drainage during warm summer growth.

documents.title: Carbon Balance in Leaf Compost
documents.full_text: Shredded autumn leaves provide carbon-rich material for a balanced household compost pile.

documents.title: Seasonal Pollinator Borders
documents.full_text: A pollinator border combines flowering plants with staggered bloom periods across the growing season.

documents.title: Clay Soil Path Construction
documents.full_text: Compacted stone and careful grading can improve the durability and drainage of garden paths on clay soil.

documents.title: Winter Storage of Root Vegetables
documents.full_text: Cool humid storage can slow moisture loss in harvested carrots and other root vegetables during winter.
